service.description: Home's counts over the user's maintenance scope (a work read; with the assigned view alone, the user's own work), narrowed to an organization or a facility (with those inside it): open, unassigned, high priority and overdue work orders, read in a few queries; the counts of overdue preventive maintenance, unknown meter readings and unavailable resources are not configured until their records exist (null, never zero). myWorkList: the user's open work, by priority and due; teamWorkList, for a broad reader only (teamTotals): per team its open, active, unscheduled, blocked and overdue work. No cost.

The cost of maintenance work (design §3 WorkCosts, §8 MaintenanceCostReport; impl-maintenance P11), for the cost reader only (MAINTENANCE_COST_VIEW with a work read; PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise, so no other caller is answered an amount): one work order (workEffortId; a step reads as its work order, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE outside the scope) with its estimate, or the work orders of the scope and the filters (any status; at most 2000, capped says so), the sources dated in the period (fromDate inclusive, thruDate exclusive). Each source once: a part issued at its asset's cost and each return naming it, less; each finished time entry, approved hours at the costing rate get#CostingRate answers for its class and work type (never a person's pay rate), unapproved and unpriced hours apart; each outside-service line from its bill, else its acceptance, once, what is ordered and not yet accepted pending. Totals by currency, never added across currencies; priced amounts by project. costs: asOf, workOrderCount, capped, totalList (per currency: parts, labor, outside, total, pending), unapprovedHours, unpricedHours, unpricedParts, projectList, currencies, sourceList (component, sourceType, sourceId, workEffortId, stepName, date, description, quantity, amount, currencyUomId, state, postingText, rateText for labor, costCenterId, projectWorkEffortId, with texts), sourcesCapped and, for one work order, estimate (known, amount, parts, labor, currencyUomId, unknownList: the Approve gate's cost half, never stored).

parameter.name: component
parameter.description: parts, labor or outside; every component when empty
